{{quotation|[[Master Dungeon Guide]]|This is the [[Fronis Irontoe's Lair|lair of Fronis Irontoe]], [[Stone Summit]] [[Dwarf]] leader and brother to unlucky gambler [[Gulnar Irontoe]]. [[Kilroy Stonekin]] tried unsuccessfully... and repeatedly... to extract Gulnar's debt from his coin purse, leaving a bruised and bloody mess behind. Distraught and penniless, Stonekin headed to the great north to track down Fronis and his owed fortune.}}

==Notes==
*It is only possible to enter this dungeon via dialogue in the required quest.
*500 [[Deldrimor_rank|Deldrimor reputation points]] are awarded for completing this dungeon for the first time in [[normal mode]], and 250 points are awarded for subsequent completions. 750 Deldrimor reputation points are awarded for completing this dungeon in [[hard mode]] for the first time, and 375 points are awarded for subsequent completions.
*There is a total of 56 enemies in this dungeon.
*Sometimes Kilroy will run past some enemies. To prevent them from being missed, he sometimes runs back, even when there are no enemies there.
*Although both bosses have an [[elite skill]], neither can be captured because your character's skill set is replaced by the Dwarven Brawler set.
*Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #16 of the [[Master Dungeon Guide]] [[storybook]].

{{bug|Sometimes the locked chest will spawn inside a wall.}}
{{bug|Sometimes Kilroy may get stuck behind the locked chest that has spawned in his way, if you lure a Stone Summit near him he will often get free, otherwise you will have to continue without him.}}
{{bug|The first Enslaved Ettin doesn't refresh the duration of [[Scroll of Rampager's Insight]], but works properly with [[Scroll of Berserker's Insight]].}}
